title: Titanium Multi-Port Gas Manifold
alloyReason: UHP-melted Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400, interstitial oxygen <500 ppm) is specified for Titanium Multi-Port Gas Manifold in semiconductor applications where metallic contamination below 1×10¹⁰ atoms/cm² is mandatory. The VAR+ESR double-melting sequence reduces non-metallic inclusion content by three orders of magnitude compared to single-melt CP grades. This purity standard is non-negotiable for Monoblock multi-port gas mixing manifold in front-end wafer processing environments. This rationale is driven by monoblock multi-port gas mixing manifold and specific design requirements.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for gas delivery geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse with 0.5mm corner radius
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 with 0.5mm corner radius
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for monoblock multiport gas application
commonFailures: Metal particle shedding >1e10 at/cm2 - eliminated by UHP VAR+ESR double-melt + electropolished ID — critical for monoblock multiport gas performance

faq.q: What outgassing properties does Titanium Multi-Port Gas Manifold have in vacuum environments?
faq.a: Grade 2 CP-Ti exhibits outgassing rates below 1×10⁻¹² Torr·L/s·cm² after bake-out at 200°C for 4 hours, compliant with SEMI F3 and ASTM E595 requirements. Total mass loss (TML) <0.1% and collected volatile condensable materials (CVCM) <0.01% per ASTM E595. This makes Titanium Multi-Port Gas Manifold suitable for monoblock multiport gas in UHV processing chambers down to 1×10⁻¹⁰ Torr.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium Multi-Port Gas Manifold orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium Multi-Port Gas Manifold is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium Multi-Port Gas Manifold?
faq.a: Each Titanium Multi-Port Gas Manifold shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for monoblock multiport gas.
